bodySections.heading: Why timing matters for this schedule
paragraphs: Plan American Water Spaniel social milestones around the schedule rows, not the other way around, because the 16-week finish is the usual green light clinics cite for broader American Water Spaniel exposure.
Weight range 25-45 lb (11-20 kg) and grooming needs (Curly coat care.) belong in the same American Water Spaniel household ops list as vaccine dates when busy weeks collide.
If your American Water Spaniel is also monitored for ear infections, ask whether bloodwork or orthopedic checks can share a visit with a booster to cut missed American Water Spaniel appointments.
After the American Water Spaniel puppy/kitten series, keep adult DA2PP / DHPP and rabies renewals on 7/3/1-day reminders so year-two surprises disappear.

bodySections.heading: If a dose is missed or delayed
paragraphs: Owners postpone American Water Spaniel shots when the puppy seems “a little off,” travel intervenes, or hip dysplasia worries dominate the week — ask the clinic whether a same-week American Water Spaniel make-up is still appropriate instead of sliding to the annual exam.
Long gaps can leave American Water Spaniel antibody levels uncertain, so expect either an added booster or a titer conversation rather than a shrug.
Do not trade the missed American Water Spaniel dose for extra socialization; finish immunity first for this medium dog.
Reset the American Water Spaniel reminder stack the evening of the make-up appointment — including the eventual adult booster after the 16-week finish.

faqs.question: When does the American Water Spaniel core vaccine series usually finish?
faqs.answer: This breed record completes core vaccines around 16 weeks of age, with rabies timed per local law. Your clinic may adjust intervals for the individual puppy.

faqs.question: What should I do if my American Water Spaniel misses a booster?
faqs.answer: Contact your veterinarian for a catch-up plan instead of restarting or skipping ahead. Keep prior dates handy and limit high-risk exposure until the series is current again.

faqs.question: Where can I read American Water Spaniel health context beyond vaccines?
faqs.answer: See the American Water Spaniel adult health guide for breed predispositions such as hip dysplasia, then bring those notes to wellness and vaccine visits.
